columns.label: perp
notes: Kalshi does not publish a maintenance margin rate; liquidation is shown where the margin is used up until you enter one.
Fees are the tier-0 rates in Kalshi's CFTC perps fee filing.
Max leverage is 6x per Kalshi's contract specs.
No maintenance margin set: liquidation is shown where the margin is used up.

columns.label: kalshi tiny funding
notes: Kalshi does not publish a maintenance margin rate; liquidation is shown where the margin is used up until you enter one.
Fees are the tier-0 rates in Kalshi's CFTC perps fee filing.
Max leverage is 6x per Kalshi's contract specs.

columns.label: perp 2
notes: Max leverage is set per market; the docs' FAQ gives up to 20x for crypto, the S&P 500, oil, gold and silver, and up to 10x for other real-world assets.
Funding scale is 1.0 for crypto and 0.5 otherwise; the default rate is the docs' formula at zero premium.

columns.label: perp 3
notes: Max leverage is set per market, from 3x to 40x; 40x is the top of the range.
Fees are the base-tier rates for validator-operated perps.

sizing_note: Equal dollars: $1,000 each. Perp sized at 3x with liquidation at $63,333. Kalshi tiny funding sized at 3x with liquidation at $63,333. Perp 2 sized at 20x with liquidation at $92,564. Perp 3 sized at 10x with liquidation at $103,210.
